scope: Six alternating fresh-process trials per case/version using macOS public JSC. Cold: one context. Sequence: 32 serial fresh contexts/groups without forced GC. Native HTTP mocks have zero latency and drain before completion. Unchanged cases require the same bytes/request counts. New conversion cases require original words with no alternative translation: mixed Chinese/Latin 1 to 0 HTTP, stale conversion cache 0 to 0, service-detected Chinese 1 to 1 cold. Runtime hashes retained per trial. Includes harness/JIT/allocator costs, not iPhone Loon, host buffers or VPN acceptance.
